chat.welcome:
**Welcome to Global Nature Watch Horizon!**

Hi, I''m your nature monitoring assistant, powered by AI and open data from [Global Nature Watch](https://globalnaturewatch.org) and [Land & Carbon Lab](https://landcarbonlab.org).

You can ask me about land cover change, forest loss, or biodiversity risks in places you care about. For more details on how to get started, check out the [Help Center](https://help.horizon.globalnaturewatch.org/get-started).
chat.samplePrompt.1: What are the trends in natural grassland area in Bolivia since 2015?
chat.samplePrompt.2: What were the top three causes of tree loss in Brazil?
chat.samplePrompt.3: Show the biggest changes in land cover in Kenya between 2015 and 2024.
chat.samplePrompt.4: How much of the Democratic Republic of Congo is natural land?
chat.samplePrompt.5: In which provinces of Indonesia have restoration efforts focused most?
chat.samplePrompt.6: Show changes in grassland extent in Mongolia.
chat.samplePrompt.7: Show how much forest loss is due to wildfires in Portugal?
chat.samplePrompt.8: How much natural land was converted to cropland in Spain between 2015 and 2024?
chat.samplePrompt.9: What are the net carbon emissions from deforestation in Peru?
chat.samplePrompt.10: Show recent forest disturbance alerts in Cambodia.
chat.samplePrompt.11: How much deforestation is linked to cocoa production in Côte d''Ivoire?
chat.samplePrompt.12: What percentage of the Phillippines was covered by trees in 2000?
chat.samplePrompt.13: What are the top 3 land cover types in Colombia?
chat.samplePrompt.14: Which country has the most natural grasslands?
chat.samplePrompt.15: How much tropical primary rainforest was lost in 2025?
chat.samplePrompt.16: How much tropical forest was deforested since 2002?
chat.samplePrompt.17: Rank the top ten countries with the largest area of tropical primary rainforest loss in 2025
